keyVerseDR: "Take courage, and be strong. Fear not... because the Lord thy God is with thee." (Jos 1:9)

level1.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Courage
level1.story: Courage means doing and saying what is right, even when it is hard or scary. God is always with you!
level1.keyLine: God is with me. I can be brave.
level1.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice courage all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: When was someone in our family brave this week?
What helps us feel brave when we are afraid?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
level1.prayer: Jesus, You are with me always. Give me courage to do what is right. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Try something new even if you feel shy
TUE: Say sorry first after an argument
WED: Stand up for someone left out
THU: Pray when you feel afraid
FRI: Raise your hand to answer at school
SAT: Tell the truth even when it is hard

level2.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Courage
level2.story: Courage, or bravery, means speaking and acting for what is right even when it is hard or scary. Brave people still feel afraid, but they trust God and do the right thing anyway. God told Joshua to be strong and not to fear, because He would be with him everywhere he went. Martyrs and saints show us that real courage comes from loving God more than we fear.
level2.keyLine: God is with me. I can be brave.
level2.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice courage all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: When was someone in our family brave this week?
How did God help us grow in courage?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
level2.prayer: Jesus, You are with me always. Give me courage to do what is right. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Speak up kindly when something is wrong
TUE: Invite someone sitting alone to join you
WED: Say no to something you know is wrong
THU: Make the Sign of the Cross before eating out
FRI: Face one fear with a parent's help
SAT: Pray for people who are persecuted

art.mainBrief: A Catholic family practicing courage together at home
art.heartBrief: Stars and a family around a heart
